purpose: Teach: もどっ/はさん/つくし/心中/少く/いれる/前もって/申しわけ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家にもどって来られたわよ
lines.style: Warm, low voice calling out to a child in the next room. Gentle announcement, the kind that settles things into place. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが本にしおりをはさんで下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad put a bookmark in his book for me.
lines.style: Bright, immediate rush of excitement. Speaking quickly because the moment is still fresh and important. Wonder at the smallness of the kindness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと一緒に春に土つくしを摘みに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go pick tsukushi with Dad when spring comes?
lines.style: Inviting, forward-looking tone. Phrasing it as a gentle suggestion rather than a plan. Warmth and possibility wrapped together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは心中、ぼくを誇りに思って下さってるって
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he's proud of me in his heart.
lines.style: Careful, shy precision in the words. Speaking like he's still turning this over in his mind, checking that he said it right. Tender amazement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、寒くなったから少く厚着しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, it's getting cold now—let's bundle you up, okay?
lines.style: Practical, attentive tone. The kind of check-in a mother makes half-automatically. Matter-of-fact but with an undertone of care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお茶をいれるお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I helped Dad make tea.
lines.style: Proud and earnest. Speaking like this was real work, real contribution. A small voice that knows he did something right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、明日の遠足は前もって準備しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's get ready for tomorrow's field trip ahead of time, okay?
lines.style: Organized, matter-of-fact. A gentle directive wrapped in inclusivity. The voice of someone thinking one step ahead.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「申しわけない」って言えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I told Dad I was sorry.
lines.style: Quiet triumph in the opening. Speaking carefully, like he's just set down something fragile that held his weight. Pride and relief mixing together.
